selectionPurpose: choose one bounded completed case for the first controlled Methods-Models demonstration; selection itself creates no scientific evidence
candidateSetScope: registered CP7 candidate plus scientific deltas admitted before selection; not an exhaustive inventory of the entire scientific portfolio

selectionRule.primary: prefer a completed case with explicit source identity, frozen scientific standing, visible limitations, no hidden-outcome requirement, no claim upgrade requirement, and a bounded demonstration slice that leaves Frontier study ownership intact
selectionRule.antiCherryPick: when selecting within an already frozen multi-case source, use a pre-existing non-performance order rather than selecting the highest-scoring case

candidates.caseTitle: Bio-Lab Inc. Conyers Fire and Chemical Release
candidates.selectionBasis: first case in the pre-existing frozen PR709 selection order; not selected for having the strongest score

candidates.claimCeiling: retrospective TC-RADAR structural early-warning evidence only; not constitutive-route identification, causality, prospectivity, or universality
candidates.trajectorySpecificationBoundary: executed M_t is a 6-36h-gated raw difference rather than the previously preferred time-normalized slope
candidates.selectionBasis: meaningful new empirical signal, but the first demonstration should use the completed source with the simpler fixed standing and fewer unresolved trajectory/mechanistic qualifications
